1. (Currently Amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (IIa), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound is prepared by a method comprising the step of treating a ß-keto ester with sodium hydride or sodium in a non-aqueous solvent__.

2. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is methyl and the sodium salt is formed in situ during the preparation method__.

3. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is methyl, __prepared by treatment of a methyl ß-keto ester with sodium hydride in a non-aqueous solvent__.

4. (Currently Amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (IIb) in which substituent Z is sodium, __wherein the compound is prepared by a method comprising the step of treating a methyl ß-keto ester with sodium hydride or sodium metal in a non-aqueous solvent__.

5. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (IIb) in which Z is sodium, __prepared by direct treatment of a methyl ß-keto ester with sodium hydride in a non-aqueous solvent to form the sodium enolate in situ__.
